reviews.title: Très pratique et efficace, même pour les chats les plus réticents
reviews.body:
J’ai testé pas mal de brosses pour chats, mais celle-ci sort clairement du lot. Mon chat n’est pas toujours très coopératif quand il s'agit de toilettage, mais avec la Hertzko, ça passe beaucoup mieux. Les picots sont suffisamment souple pour ne pas irriter la peau, tout en attrapant bien les poils morts.
Le gros plus, c’est le système autonettoyant. On appuie sur le bouton, la plaque se rétracte, et les poils s’enlèvent d’un coup, sans avoir à galérer à les retirer à la main. Vraiment pratique au quotidien, surtout quand on brosse souvent.
Bonne prise en main, facile à nettoyer, et solide dans le temps. Un excellent accessoire pour entretenir le pelage de son chat sans prise de tête.
reviews.date: Reseñado en Francia el 4 de mayo de 2025

reviews.title: Makes Cats Love You
reviews.body:
So my family has 4 cats, 2 of them long haired. The boy cat, Shadow, and my dad have been thick as thieves. My dad uses a cart as a walker and Shadow will ride it around with dad, watch TV with him, snuggle with him, etc. He was the son my dad never had. Shadow has always treated me like a booty call. In the day time in front of others? Couldn't care less about me. But 3am when he wants snuggles? Slides into my room like, "Hey you up?" just to get some pets and then leave me again. Typical boy.
Only problem was Shadow's fur was getting matted. Dad insisted he had the best brush on the market, but the mats spoke for themselves. He tried other methods but Shadow wasn't a fan of those either. We tried a lion cut but he looked so sad afterwards that I will never do that to my baby again. So I did a little Google research and, after seeing some reviews, I tried this one. It's cheap, looked easy to clean, so why not give it a shot?
It's been less than a week and already Shadow has forsaken dad for me. Just the first time I tried it he was a big, black fluffball purring happily away. In just a few days I've gone from side chick for snuggles to having him simp. Honestly embarrassing for him. Now any time he feels like he needs a brushing he comes up to me and meows until I give into his demands. Or comes over and puts his head in my hands. Then he just purrs and purrs as I brush him. If I stop, he insists I keep going with aggravated meows. He wants nothing to do with dad now; only brushing. Morning, middle of the day, middle of the night... time is irrelevant to him. He even gets mad if the other cats come around or dare to use HIS brush, even though they love it just as much. All my cats turn into puddles of purrs after just a few brushes. All of their coats are looking shiny and fabulous, though the increase of them catching paws with each other to get brush time has been a bit much.
Other than that, I'm happy because the brush is so simple to use and easy to hold onto. Cleaning this brush of fur and dandruff is so much easier to do than normal brushes. My dad has used ones specifically for mats but I've had better success with this one thus far. It makes my short hair cats happy. It can tackle mats on my long hair cats. The cats are obsessed with this brush to the point of abandoning their bonded humans. Only real downside thus far is that I'm going to need to get another one for my dad so his feline son returns to him.
So if you want to take good care of your cats coat and can handle them fighting over you, then this brush is great. 5 paws out of 5.
reviews.date: Reseñado en Estados Unidos el 4 de mayo de 2024
